en: 04 – Logic Request handling logic Not a reference book of procedures, not a sales course. The simple logic for processing any client request. Message templates for specific situations – in Section 5 . Universal logic for any incoming request Any booking request goes through the same steps: Read the context – chat history + Alteg.io card (labels, comments, history) Determine the procedure type – injection / facial / hardware / body / hair / consultation Decide: is a consultation needed before the procedure? (see next section) Determine the specialist – Dr. Diana or the beauty therapist (see Section 2 ) Determine the duration – open Alteg.io, see how long this procedure type takes Ask the client's preference – morning / day / evening Propose 2 specific slots in their window, optimal for Booking Discipline Reserve the slot in Alteg.io with a procedure-type comment Check whether a reservation fee is needed ( Booking & reservation fee ). Needed: send the 210 AED Stripe link and the booking conditions. Not needed (new client with the beauty therapist, or with Dr. Diana when it isn't her first booking of the day): send the cancellation-policy message If a fee was required, confirm the booking once payment is received What you write in the booking comment in Alteg.io Always write the client's concern and what they want to discuss – especially for a consultation. The doctor should open the booking and immediately see why the client is coming. Examples: Consultation – acne on cheeks and chin for 6 months, tried creams, wants a treatment plan Consultation – pigmentation after summer, asks about IPL Lip filler – had it before, wants a bit more volume Botulinum toxin – forehead and between the brows, last time 4 months ago HydraFacial – before a wedding on Saturday How to answer the client's first message When a client writes for the first time – often from an ad – one reply should give everything they need to take the next step, without overwhelming them. Not a wall of text, not a one-line brush-off. One structured answer that moves the conversation toward a booking. The structure Answer the question, if there is one. If the client asked something specific – respond to it directly first. If there's no question, acknowledge the request warmly and confirm we can help. Give the key information. The essential context: we work with individually selected combined protocols to reach a strong, lasting result. Enough to convey value, not a full medical explanation. Explain how it works. Whether this is a direct visit or goes through a consultation. For a new client, the first step is a consultation with Dr. Diana, who builds a personal treatment plan (exceptions below). Offer dates or ask for a convenient time. Give the working schedule and either propose specific slots or ask when it suits them. End with a question. The balance Everything the client needs to decide and book – in one message. But each part is short. The client should finish reading and know exactly what the next step is, not feel buried in information. Example – client responds to an ad: "I want to treat acne" Reasoning, not a template – full template in Section 5 Yes, we'd be glad to help with acne. We use individually selected combined protocols designed to give you a strong and lasting result, rather than a one-off effect. It works like this: you come in for a consultation, and the doctor builds a personal treatment plan for you. What day and time would be most convenient for you? How consultations are charged Short consultation – "do I need this or not", up to 10–15 minutes: free, whatever the procedure. Full consultation – paid (current price in Alteg.io). If the client then follows the treatment plan, the cost of the first consultation is deducted: when they buy a package, or after 3 procedures. When a consultation is needed before the procedure The basic rule Every new patient goes to Dr. Diana for a consultation first. Exceptions The client asks for a HydraFacial or a cleansing – book straight with the beauty therapist. The client wants lips or toxin – book the procedure straight away, but still with Dr. Diana. She assesses before she starts. The client knows exactly what they need – for example, they've had this procedure before (with us or elsewhere) – you can book the procedure. A returning client continuing the plan Dr. Diana made – book the next procedure from the plan. Why you need to dig The client may think they need IPL because they have pigmentation, but if it's melasma, IPL can make it worse. So you need to roughly understand what each procedure is for ( Section 2 , Section 11 ) and, when needed, ask a couple of questions to get to the main problem. If you're not sure – book a consultation. It's always safer. Request → specialist → consultation Client request Who New client: consultation first? Botulinum toxin Diana No – straight to the procedure, Dr. Diana assesses first Lip filler Diana No – straight to the procedure Face filler, collagen stimulators, skin boosters, biorevitalization Diana Yes, unless the client has had it before Lipolytic injections, hair injections, Morpheus8 Diana Yes, unless the client has had it before Dissolving old filler Diana Yes HydraFacial, cleansing Beauty therapist No Peels, Dermapen, IPL, other facials Beauty therapist (Diana for VIP) Yes, unless the client has had it before Wonder Axon Beauty therapist Yes, unless the client has had it before Acne, scars, pigmentation, redness, hair loss Diana Always a consultation "I don't know what I need" Diana Always a consultation Home routine Diana Home care consultation Duration of each procedure – always check Alteg.io. Confirmations Every morning – send all reminders and confirmation requests that Revenelle shows Booking created, moved or cancelled – send the confirmation straight away First thing in the morning – check unconfirmed bookings; the first booking of the day is never left unconfirmed. From 14:00 – a personal follow-up to anyone silent (you can say the booking will be cancelled if not confirmed by 17:00). At 17:00 – call. Ideally, don't leave until everything for tomorrow is confirmed. Full protocol in Section 3 . Cancellation and rescheduling Live documents: Reservation & Deposit SOP · Cancellations & Reschedules tracker – log every cancellation here. Main rule Changes 24 hours or more before the visit – no problem: the reservation fee moves to the new booking (valid 3 months) or is refunded on request. Changes less than 24 hours before, or a no-show, are handled as below. Who pays a fee in the first place is on the booking page . Late cancellation or no-show – first time The client had paid a fee: as an exception, we keep it for rebooking (valid 3 months). Tell the client clearly that if they don't come again or cancel at the last minute, the fee will be forfeited. The client hadn't paid a fee: we rebook as an exception, but tell the client that after another late cancellation or no-show, the next booking will only be with a reservation fee. Add a comment to the client card with the date, so the next person sees it. Late cancellation or no-show – again The fee is not refunded, and the next booking is only with a new reservation fee. Exact wording for every case is in the SOP scripts and on the booking page . How to handle the conversation Acknowledge the client's message Explain the rule and the exception in one calm message Straight away ask about a new date: "Do you already have a date in mind, or shall we reach out a bit later?" If there's no new date – log it in the Cancellations & Reschedules tracker What matters: don't apologise for the policy – it protects the doctors' time. Always offer a solution and a new booking. Don't let the conversation end without a next step. No-show The main focus is prevention: confirmations and working with non-responders ( Section 3 ). If the client isn't there: The client is late – you call and find out. Don't wait. If no answer – write and call again in 20–30 minutes If the client didn't get in touch – mark the booking as no-show in Alteg.io Reach out the same or next day , offer to rebook and apply the rules above Follow-up after the visit Revenelle Revenelle works out who is due for a repeat visit and prepares the follow-up messages. Your job is to send them every day (see Section 9 ). Three days after the visit – fixed follow-up in WhatsApp. The day's schedule has a dedicated slot for this (see Section 7 ). Content of the message: Greeting by name Recognition of the visit and procedure (without medical detail) Question about wellbeing and skin If the client didn't leave a Google review at the clinic – a gentle request to leave one Open close – "let us know if any questions come up" Specific template – in Section 5 . Google reviews Priority – in the clinic. At the client's exit after the procedure: Ask how the visit went If the answer is positive – ask them to leave a review on Google Maps Give the client a small gift (samples) right then as thanks for the review If it didn't work in the clinic (client in a hurry, no time) – review request in the follow-up message after 3 days. Working with the sleeping base The sleeping base, birthday greetings and offer mailings are worked from Revenelle (see Section 9 ). The logic of the message below stays the same. Who is sleeping: clients who haven't been with us for 60+ days. Segments: 60–90 days (warm) 90–180 days (mid) 180+ days (cold) Daily norm: 10 messages per day from the sleeping base. The day's schedule has a dedicated slot for this (see Section 7 ). Logic of the message This is not an offer broadcast. It is an individual contact with interest in the client. Every message contains: Greeting by name Acknowledgement of the pause ("we noticed it's been a while since your last visit") Question about skin / wellbeing – no sales push Openness to the answer (even if it's "I don't want to do anything with you anymore") We do not: Send "we have a 20% discount" instead of a question Write "we miss you" without context Push or write again the next day if the client is silent What we collect Every client reply – record in the card. Especially valuable are reasons for leaving: they will become a base of typical objections that we can later work with systematically. If the client writes "not the right time, maybe in 2 months" – record the return date and come back exactly then, not earlier. Birthdays and important dates – record in the client card ( Section 3 and the comment template). Templates by segment – in Section 5 . Complaints Every complaint, medical or not, is yours to lead from the first contact to closure. The Clinic Manager knows about every complaint the same day, involves the specialist and the Medical Lead / Dr. Diana, tells you what to do and decides on any compensation. Steps, timeframes and what you can and can't offer are in Section 12 and the Complaint Handling Policy . Possible complication Severe or increasing pain, growing swelling, skin colour change, signs of infection, fever, problems with vision or breathing: tell the treating specialist, or the doctor or nurse on duty, immediately. Don't wait and don't book a regular slot. A human reply, not corporate. Not "we apologize for the inconvenience". Better: "I'm really sorry this happened, let me look into it for you." Objections Not a script, but an approach. Every objection requires: Acknowledge the client's feeling Do not apologise for the clinic's positioning Explain value, not defend price Offer a next step " Expensive " Not "we are expensive because we are the best." Better: The pricing reflects the level of care, premium products, and individual approach. The best way to see if it's right for you is a consultation – Dr. Diana will recommend the most efficient plan within your priorities. " I'll think about it " Not "well, write if you change your mind." Better: Of course. Is there something specific you'd like to consider, or any information that would help? Would it be alright if we check in with you in a week? " I already have my cosmetologist " We don't try to convince or criticise. Better: Lovely to hear you have someone you trust. If ever you're curious about a specific procedure we offer, we'd be happy to share more – no pressure. " Competitors are cheaper " Not "we are better because N." Better: Pricing varies a lot in Dubai depending on protocols, products, and approach. What matters most is the result. If you'd like, Dr. Diana can do a consultation to give you a clear plan, and you can decide if it's the right fit.
ru: 04 – Логика Логика работы с запросами Не справочник по процедурам и не учебник по продажам. Простая логика для обработки любого запроса клиента. Шаблоны конкретных сообщений – в разделе 5 . Универсальная логика обработки входящего запроса Любой запрос на запись проходит через одни и те же шаги: Прочитай контекст – переписка с клиентом + карточка в Alteg.io (лейблы, комментарии, история) Определи тип процедуры – инъекция / facial / аппаратное / тело / hair / консультация Реши: нужна ли консультация перед процедурой? (см. ниже) Определи специалиста – доктор Диана или эстетист (см. раздел 2 ) Определи длительность – открой Alteg.io, посмотри сколько занимает этот тип процедуры Спроси у клиента предпочтение – утро / день / вечер Предложи 2 конкретных слота в его окне, оптимальных для Booking Discipline Зафиксируй слот в Alteg.io с пометкой типа процедуры Проверь, нужен ли reservation fee ( страница про запись и fee ). Нужен – отправь Stripe-ссылку на 210 AED и условия записи. Не нужен (новый клиент к эстетисту или к Диане не первой записью дня) – отправь сообщение о политике отмен Если fee был нужен, подтверди запись после получения оплаты Что ты пишешь в комментарии к записи в Alteg.io Всегда пиши, с каким запросом идёт клиент и что хочет обсудить – особенно при записи на консультацию. Доктор должен открыть запись и сразу понять, зачем клиент придёт. Примеры: Consultation – acne on cheeks and chin for 6 months, tried creams, wants a treatment plan Consultation – pigmentation after summer, asks about IPL Lip filler – had it before, wants a bit more volume Botulinum toxin – forehead and between the brows, last time 4 months ago HydraFacial – before a wedding on Saturday Как отвечать на первое сообщение клиента Когда клиент пишет впервые – часто с рекламы – один ответ должен дать всё необходимое для следующего шага, не перегружая. Не простыня текста и не односложная отписка. Один структурированный ответ, который ведёт диалог к записи. Структура Ответь на вопрос, если он есть. Если клиент спросил что-то конкретное – сначала прямо отвечаешь на это. Если вопроса нет – тепло принимаешь запрос и подтверждаешь, что мы поможем. Дай важную информацию. Суть: мы работаем с индивидуально подобранными комбинированными протоколами, чтобы достичь максимального и устойчивого результата. Достаточно, чтобы передать ценность, без полного медицинского разбора. Объясни, как это работает. Это прямой визит или через консультацию. Для нового клиента первый шаг – консультация у доктора Дианы, она составляет персональный план лечения (исключения ниже). Предложи даты или спроси удобное время. Даёшь график работы и либо предлагаешь конкретные слоты, либо спрашиваешь, когда удобно. Заканчиваешь вопросом. Баланс Всё, что нужно клиенту, чтобы решиться и записаться, – в одном сообщении. Но каждая часть короткая. Клиент дочитывает и точно знает следующий шаг, а не тонет в информации. Пример – клиент с рекламы: «хочу полечить акне» Логика, не шаблон – готовый шаблон в разделе 5 Да, мы с радостью поможем с акне. Мы используем индивидуально подобранные комбинированные протоколы, чтобы достичь устойчивого результата, а не разового эффекта. Это работает так: вы приходите на консультацию, врач составляет персональный план лечения. В какой день и время вам удобнее? Как оплачивается консультация Короткая консультация – «надо / не надо», до 10–15 минут: бесплатно, вне зависимости от процедуры. Полноценная консультация – платная (актуальная цена в Alteg.io). Если клиент потом идёт по протоколу, стоимость первой консультации вычитаем: при покупке абонемента или после 3 процедур. Когда нужна консультация перед процедурой Базовое правило Любой новый пациент сначала идёт к доктору Диане на консультацию. Исключения Клиент просит хайдрафейшл или чистку – сразу записываешь к эстетисту. Клиент хочет губы или ботокс – сразу записываешь на процедуру, но всё равно к доктору Диане. Она оценит перед началом. Клиент точно знает, что ему нужно, – например, уже делал эту процедуру (у нас или в другом месте), – можно записать на процедуру. Постоянный клиент продолжает план, который составила доктор Диана, – записываешь на следующую процедуру из плана. Почему нужно докапываться Клиент может думать, что ему нужен IPL, потому что у него пигментация, а там мелазма, и IPL может её усилить. Поэтому тебе нужно хотя бы примерно понимать, какая процедура для чего ( раздел 2 , раздел 11 ), и при необходимости задать пару вопросов, чтобы докопаться до основной проблемы. Не уверена – записывай на консультацию. Это всегда безопаснее. Запрос → специалист → консультация Запрос клиента К кому Новый клиент: сначала консультация? Ботулотоксин Diana Нет – сразу на процедуру, Диана оценивает перед началом Филлер губ Diana Нет – сразу на процедуру Филлер лица, стимуляторы коллагена, скинбустеры, биоревитализация Diana Да, если клиент не делал это раньше Липолитики, инъекции для волос, Morpheus8 Diana Да, если клиент не делал это раньше Растворить старый филлер Diana Да HydraFacial, чистка Эстетист Нет Пилинги, Dermapen, IPL, другие уходы Эстетист (Диана для VIP) Да, если клиент не делал это раньше Wonder Axon Эстетист Да, если клиент не делал это раньше Акне, рубцы, пигментация, покраснения, выпадение волос Diana Всегда консультация «Не знаю, что мне нужно» Diana Всегда консультация Домашний уход Diana Консультация по домашнему уходу Длительность каждой процедуры – всегда смотри в Alteg.io. Подтверждения Каждое утро – отправляешь все напоминания и запросы на подтверждение, которые показывает Revenelle Запись создана, перенесена или отменена – подтверждение отправляешь сразу Первым делом утром – проверить неподтверждённые записи; первую запись дня неподтверждённой не оставляешь никогда. С 14:00 – персональный follow-up всем, кто молчит (можно написать, что запись отменится, если её не подтвердят до 17:00). В 17:00 – звонок. В идеале не уходишь, пока всё на завтра не подтверждено. Полный протокол в разделе 3 . Отмена и перенос Живые документы: СОП по бронированиям и депозитам · Трекер отмен и переносов – фиксируешь каждую отмену здесь. Главное правило Изменения за 24 часа и больше до визита – без проблем: reservation fee переходит на новую запись (действует 3 месяца) или возвращается по запросу. Изменения менее чем за 24 часа или no-show – как ниже. Кто вообще платит fee – на странице про запись . Поздняя отмена или no-show – первый раз Клиент платил fee: как исключение сохраняем его на перезапись (действует 3 месяца). Чётко предупреждаешь, что если клиент снова не придёт или отменит в последний момент, fee сгорит. Клиент не платил fee: записываем как исключение, но предупреждаешь, что после следующей поздней отмены или неявки следующая запись будет только с reservation fee. Оставляешь комментарий в карточке клиента с датой, чтобы следующий человек это видел. Поздняя отмена или no-show – повторно Fee не возвращается, следующая запись – только с новым reservation fee. Точные формулировки для каждого случая – в скриптах SOP и на странице про запись . Как вести разговор Признать сообщение клиента Спокойно, одним сообщением объяснить правило и исключение Сразу спросить про новую дату: «Do you already have a date in mind, or shall we reach out a bit later?» Если новой даты нет – внести в трекер отмен и переносов Что важно: не извиняйся за политику – она защищает время врачей. Всегда предлагай решение и новую запись. Не позволяй разговору закончиться без следующего шага. No-show Главный фокус – профилактика: подтверждения и работа с неответившими ( раздел 3 ). Если клиента нет: Клиент опаздывает – звонишь и узнаёшь. Не ждёшь. Если не отвечает – пишешь и через 20–30 минут звонишь снова Если клиент так и не вышел на связь – отмечаешь запись в Alteg.io как no-show В тот же или на следующий день связываешься , предлагаешь перезапись и применяешь правила выше Follow-up после визита Revenelle Revenelle сам вычисляет, кому пора на повторный визит, и готовит фоллоуапы. Твоя задача – отправлять их каждый день (см. раздел 9 ). Через 3 дня после визита – фиксированный follow-up в WhatsApp. Время в дне выделено отдельно (см. раздел 7 ). Содержание сообщения: Обращение по имени Признание визита и процедуры (без медицинских деталей) Вопрос о самочувствии и коже Если клиент не оставил Google-отзыв в клинике – мягкая просьба оставить отзыв Открытый финал – «let us know if any questions come up» Конкретный шаблон – в разделе 5 . Google-отзывы Приоритет – в клинике. При выходе клиента после процедуры: Спросить, как прошёл визит Если ответ позитивный – попросить оставить отзыв на Google Maps Дать клиенту подарок (пробники) в благодарность за отзыв сразу же Если в клинике не получилось (клиент торопился, не было времени) – запрос на отзыв в follow-up сообщении через 3 дня. Работа со спящей базой Спящая база, поздравления с днём рождения и рассылки с офферами ведутся из Revenelle (см. раздел 9 ). Логика сообщения ниже остаётся той же. Кто считается спящим: клиенты, которые не были у нас 60+ дней. Сегменты: 60–90 дней (тёплый) 90–180 дней (средний) 180+ дней (холодный) Норма дня: 10 сообщений в день из спящей базы. Время в дне выделено отдельно (см. раздел 7 ). Логика сообщения Это не рассылка офферов. Это индивидуальный контакт с интересом к клиенту. Каждое сообщение содержит: Обращение по имени Признание паузы («we noticed it's been a while since your last visit») Вопрос о коже/самочувствии – без продажи Открытость к ответу (даже если ответ «не хочу больше у вас лечиться») Не делаем: Отправляем «we have a 20% discount» вместо вопроса Пишем «we miss you» без контекста Давим, пишем повторно через день если клиент молчит Что собираем Каждый ответ клиента – фиксируем в карточке. Особенно ценны причины ухода: они станут базой типичных возражений, по которой мы потом сможем системно работать. Если клиент пишет «сейчас не до этого, может через 2 месяца» – фиксируем дату возврата и возвращаемся именно тогда, не раньше. Дни рождения и важные даты – записываем в карточку клиента ( раздел 3 и шаблон комментариев). Шаблоны сообщений по сегментам – в разделе 5 . Жалобы Каждую жалобу, медицинскую или нет, ведёшь ты от первого обращения до закрытия. Clinic Manager знает о каждой жалобе в тот же день, подключает специалиста и Medical Lead / доктора Диану, говорит тебе, что делать, и решает любую компенсацию. Шаги, сроки и что можно и нельзя предлагать – в разделе 12 и в политике по жалобам . Возможное осложнение Сильная или нарастающая боль, растущий отёк, изменение цвета кожи, признаки инфекции, температура, проблемы со зрением или дыханием: сразу сообщаешь специалисту, который делал процедуру, или дежурному врачу или медсестре. Не ждёшь и не записываешь на обычный слот. Ответ человеческий, не корпоративный. Не «we apologize for the inconvenience». Лучше: «I'm really sorry this happened, let me look into it for you.» Возражения Не флоу, а подход. Каждое возражение требует: Признать чувство клиента Не оправдываться за позиционирование Объяснить ценность, а не защищать цену Предложить следующий шаг " Дорого " Не «мы дорогие, потому что лучшие». Лучше: The pricing reflects the level of care, premium products, and individual approach. The best way to see if it's right for you is a consultation – Dr. Diana will recommend the most efficient plan within your priorities. " Я подумаю " Не «ну хорошо, пишите, если надумаете». Лучше: Of course. Is there something specific you'd like to consider, or any information that would help? Would it be alright if we check in with you in a week? " У меня уже есть свой косметолог " Не пытаемся переубедить или критиковать. Лучше: Lovely to hear you have someone you trust. If ever you're curious about a specific procedure we offer, we'd be happy to share more – no pressure. " У конкурентов дешевле " Не «у нас лучше потому что N». Лучше: Pricing varies a lot in Dubai depending on protocols, products, and approach. What matters most is the result. If you'd like, Dr. Diana can do a consultation to give you a clear plan, and you can decide if it's the right fit.

en: 05 – Templates Message templates Ready-to-edit English templates for every situation. Copy, edit for the specific client, send. How to use these templates: Always edit the template for the specific client and their specific question – never send blindly Add the client's name where you see [Name] Fill in concrete details where you see square brackets [like this] If the template doesn't fully answer the client's question – extend it, don't force-fit Match the tone to what the client wrote – if they wrote one short sentence, your reply doesn't need to be a wall of text A. Incoming inquiries First contact, new clients, broad questions about treatments and prices. A1 Clarifying a broad inquiry Use when the client asks "what do you have" / "tell me about your services" without specifying. Hi [Name], thank you for reaching out to Cosmo Di! To help guide you to the right option – what are you mainly looking to address? For example: anti-wrinkle injections, lip or face contouring with fillers, skin quality and hydration (biorevitalization), facial treatments, peels, body sculpting, or something else? Once I know your focus, I can share the relevant options and pricing, and we can find the right approach for you. A2 Replying with a price for a specific procedure Client knows what they want. Open Alteg.io for the exact price before sending. Hi [Name], happy to share. Our [procedure name] with Dr. Diana / our beauty therapist starts from AED [price]. The procedure takes around [duration] and the result typically lasts [duration of effect]. Would you like me to find a slot for you this week? Mornings, afternoons, or evenings work better for you? A3 Sending full price list (when client insists) When the client wants to see everything before deciding. Never just dump a price list without context. Of course, [Name] – please find our pricing for [category] below. [paste relevant pricing] At the consultation Dr. Diana will recommend what suits your skin and the result you'd like – that's how we get natural, lasting results rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. Would you like me to book you in for a consultation so Dr. Diana can recommend the optimal plan for you? A4 Booking confirmation with reservation fee link Only when a reservation fee is required ( who pays ). Send right after reserving the booking in Alteg.io. If no fee is needed, send A4b instead. Wonderful, [Name] – I have reserved [day, date] at [time] with Dr. Diana / our beauty therapist for your [procedure type]. To secure your appointment, we kindly ask for a time reservation of AED 210 via the link below. This amount is fully applied toward your treatment on the day – it simply holds your slot: https://buy.stripe.com/eVqfZie2J6eDfJ0d4j2sM02 Just a note on our policy: for changes made more than 24 hours before the visit, the reservation fee is transferred to your next visit or refunded on request. For changes within 24 hours, it is non-refundable. Looking forward to seeing you! A4b Booking confirmation without a fee – cancellation policy New client booked without a reservation fee: with the beauty therapist, or with Dr. Diana when it isn't her first booking of the day. Always send. Hi [Name], you're booked in with [Dr. Diana / specialist's name] on [Date] at [Time] for [Treatment]! 🤍 Please note our cancellation policy: appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled up to 24 hours in advance at no charge. For changes made with less than 24 hours' notice, a 210 AED reservation fee will be required to secure your next booking. We look forward to welcoming you! 🤍 A5 Booking a consultation For requests like "I have acne", "I want to look younger", "I don't know what I need". Check the consultation price in Alteg.io before sending. A short "do I need this or not" consultation (up to 10–15 minutes) is free – then you don't mention a price. How consultations are charged: Section 4 . Hi [Name], [concern] is exactly the kind of thing Dr. Diana works with regularly. The right first step here is a [Acne / VISIA / Procedure] Consultation – she'll examine your skin in detail, identify the underlying cause, and put together a personalised plan combining the right procedures and home care for your specific case. The consultation is AED [price]. If you then go ahead with the treatment plan, this amount is deducted – when you choose a package, or after your first 3 procedures. When works best for you – morning, afternoon, or evening? I'd be happy to find a couple of options. A6 Offering specific slots After the client tells you their preferred part of the day. Offer two specific slots optimal for Booking Discipline. Perfect, [Name]. I have [day] at [time] or [day] at [time] available. Which one works better for you? A7 First reply to an ad inquiry (concern-based) Client writes from an ad with a concern ("I want to treat acne", "I have pigmentation"). One reply: value + how it works + scheduling. Logic in Section 4 . Hi [Name], yes – we'd be glad to help with [concern]. We use individually selected combined protocols designed to give you a strong and lasting result, rather than a one-off effect. It works like this: you come in for a consultation, and Dr. Diana builds a personal treatment plan for you. What day and time would be most convenient for you? If the client asks about the price, use the consultation lines from A5. B. Confirmations and follow-up Reminders (B1) and confirmations (B2) are sent by you from Revenelle: reminders every morning, confirmations as soon as a booking is created or changed. Revenelle prepares the text; B1 and B2 show what it should say. Then work with anyone who didn't reply: first thing in the morning for today's first bookings, from 14:00 for tomorrow (B3), at 17:00 – call. B1 Reminder – from Revenelle, every morning You send it from Revenelle in the morning, for the upcoming appointments it shows. Hi [Name], a friendly reminder that we have you booked tomorrow, [day, date] at [time], for your [procedure] with Dr. Diana / our beauty therapist. Could you please confirm that you'll be coming? Just a quick "yes" or "see you tomorrow" works. B2 Visit-day confirmation – from Revenelle You send it from Revenelle on the morning of the visit. Good morning, [Name]! Just confirming we're seeing you today at [time]. Looking forward to it – see you soon. B3 Follow-up to a non-responder (you send this) From 14:00, to anyone who didn't reply to the reminder. You can add the last line about 17:00. If there's still no reply at 17:00 – call. Hi [Name], just checking in – could you please confirm your visit tomorrow at [time]? We want to make sure everything is ready for you. [optional] If we don't hear from you by 5 pm, we'll need to release the slot. C. Cancellation and rescheduling Handling requests to cancel or reschedule. The rules are in Section 4 and on the booking page ; the full scripts are in the SOP. C1 Late cancellation or no-show, fee was paid – first time Acknowledge, explain the rule, keep the fee once as an exception, warn about next time, ask about a new date. Add a card comment. Hi [Name], thank you for letting us know. As per our booking conditions, the reservation fee is non-refundable for changes made less than 24 hours in advance. As an exception this time, we'll keep your 210 AED reservation fee for 3 months so you can use it for your next visit. Please note this can only be done once – if a booking is missed or cancelled late again, the fee will not be kept. Do you already have a date in mind, or shall we reach out a bit later? C1b Late cancellation or no-show, no fee was paid – first time Rebook as an exception and warn that next time a reservation fee will be required. Add a card comment. Hi [Name], thank you for letting us know. Because this change came less than 24 hours before the appointment, our policy is to ask for a 210 AED reservation fee for future bookings. As this is the first time, we'll make an exception and rebook you without it – but if a booking is cancelled late or missed again, the next one will need a reservation fee (fully credited toward your treatment). When would you like to come in instead? C2 Cancellation 24 hours or more in advance Standard rescheduling. If a fee was paid, it moves to the new booking. Of course, [Name] – no problem at all, thank you for letting us know in advance. [If a fee was paid:] Your reservation fee stays with us and is valid for 3 months. When would you like to come in instead? Do you already have a preferred day, or shall I suggest a few options? C3 Reschedule confirmation Perfect, [Name] – I've moved your booking to [new day, date] at [time] with [specialist]. [If a fee was paid:] Your reservation fee is applied to this visit. I'll send you a reminder closer to the date. See you then! D. No-show and follow-up After a missed appointment, post-visit follow-up, Google review request. D1 After a no-show (same or next day) Send after a no-show when the client didn't answer your calls. Tone is warm, not reproachful. When they reply, use C1 or C1b. Hi [Name], we missed you on [day, date] and hope everything is well on your side. Would you like to find another time? I'd be happy to look at the schedule with you. D2 Follow-up 3 days after visit Sent in WhatsApp 3 days after the procedure. Genuine care, not a sales push. Hi [Name], hope you've been doing well after your visit on [day]! How are you feeling, and how is your skin settling? If anything has come up or you have any questions, please don't hesitate to let us know – we're here. D3 Google review request (in follow-up) Only use if the client didn't leave a review at the clinic. Combine with D2. [continuing from D2] If you have a moment and you're happy with your experience at Cosmo Di, a short Google review would mean the world to us – it really helps other women discover us. Here's the link: [Google review link] Thank you so much for being with us. E. Sleeping base reactivation Reaching out to clients who haven't been with us for 60+ days. Individual, not bulk. No offers – questions. Before sending – open the client card. Adjust each template to mention the specific procedure they had last, their preferences, anything personal you know. E1 60–90 days (warm) Reference their last procedure naturally. Focus is "how is your skin doing". Hi [Name], it's been about [X] weeks since your [procedure] with us, and we just wanted to check in – how is your skin feeling? Are you happy with how the result has been holding? If anything is on your mind, or if it feels like a good time to plan the next step, we'd love to hear from you. E2 90–180 days (mid) More space for the client to reflect. Open the door without pushing. Hi [Name], it's been a little while since we last saw you, and I wanted to reach out personally to ask – how have things been on the skin care side? Sometimes a few months after a [procedure type / treatment course], a gentle touch-up or refresh can really help maintain the result. If you'd like, Dr. Diana could take a look and suggest what makes sense at this stage – no pressure either way. Would it be helpful to chat about it? E3 180+ days (cold) Longer message. Sincere interest. Be open to "we're not coming back" as a valid answer. Hi [Name], it's been quite some time since we've heard from you, and I wanted to reach out – not to sell you anything, but genuinely to ask how you are. How is your skin feeling these days? Is there anything we could have done differently, or anything that didn't work for you last time? Whatever your answer, we'd really value hearing it. And if at any point you feel like coming back for a fresh assessment, Dr. Diana would be glad to see you. E4 Filling an open slot (proactive) When there's a gap in tomorrow's schedule and you want to invite a specific client to fill it. Hi [Name], a slot opened up tomorrow at [time] with Dr. Diana / our beauty therapist – and you came to mind. If you've been thinking about [procedure / treatment], this could be a lovely opportunity. Would it work for you? F. Complaints and difficult situations Medical concerns, service issues, discount requests. Always human, never corporate. F1 Concern about a result or a reaction Client writes about a skin reaction, pain or an unexpected effect. Don't interpret. A possible complication goes to the specialist, doctor or nurse on duty immediately; everything else follows Section 12 . Hi [Name], thank you for letting us know – let's make sure this is taken care of right away. I'll pass this to [specialist], who performed your procedure, so they can review it. Could you please send a few clear photos and a short description of what you're noticing? I'll come back to you as soon as I have their feedback. F2 Service complaint – acknowledge and look into it Delay, confusion, anything client-experience related. Say you're sorry the client is unhappy, don't make excuses and don't promise compensation. Then check the facts and report to the Clinic Manager ( Section 12 ). [Name], I'm really sorry to hear about your experience – we take this seriously. I'm looking into what happened and will come back to you by [day]. Again, thank you for telling us – it genuinely matters. F3 Discount request – when you decide not to give one Use this when a discount isn't justified (see the limits in Section 10 ). Acknowledge the request and explain the value. If the client asks for more than your limit, message the Clinic Manager. Hi [Name], thank you for asking. Our pricing reflects the level of care, the premium products we use, and the individual approach Dr. Diana takes with every client. For this reason, we generally don't offer discounts. What we can do is make sure the plan recommended for you is truly the most efficient one for your priorities – Dr. Diana is very mindful about that during consultation. Would it help to chat about which procedures would give you the most value? G. Objections Don't defend the price – explain the value. Don't argue – propose a next step. G1 " Expensive " I completely understand – and that's a fair thing to consider. Our pricing reflects the level of care, premium products, and individual approach Dr. Diana takes with every client. It's why our clients tend to come back and stay with us. The best way to see if it's right for you is a consultation – Dr. Diana will recommend the most efficient plan within your priorities, so you know exactly what you're investing in. Would you like to come in for that? G2 " I'll think about it " Of course, [Name] – take your time. Is there something specific you'd like to think over, or any information that would help you decide? In the meantime, would it be okay if I check in with you in a week or so? G3 " I have my own cosmetologist " Lovely to hear you have someone you trust – that matters. If ever you're curious about a specific procedure we offer (like Morpheus8, or our biorevitalization protocols, or our Wonder Axon body work), we'd be happy to share more, no pressure at all. In the meantime – we're here whenever you'd like to chat. G4 " Competitors are cheaper " Pricing varies a lot in Dubai depending on the protocols, the products, and the doctor's approach – so the headline price doesn't always tell the full story. What matters most is the result, and how it holds. If you'd like, Dr. Diana can do a Procedure Consultation, give you a clear plan, and you can decide from there whether the value works for you. Would you like to book that? Closing notes Phrases for closing conversations gracefully when the booking is confirmed or the client is taking time to decide. Z1 After booking confirmed All set, [Name] – we'll see you on [day] at [time]. If anything comes up before then, just let us know. Looking forward to it! Z2 When client is undecided Take your time, [Name]. Whenever you're ready, we're here – no rush at all. A note on tone These templates are written in a warm, premium tone. Every word is chosen – verbs like "wonderful", "lovely", "of course"; openings like "happy to share", "thank you for asking"; closings like "looking forward to it", "we're here". This is not call-centre English, and it's not casual texting either. It is the voice of a clinic that takes its clients seriously. If a template feels stiff for a particular client (some clients prefer very brief replies), soften it. If a template feels too casual (some clients are very formal), make it slightly more reserved. The templates are starting points – your judgement on the specific client is the final word.

Подтверждения и follow-up Напоминания (B1) и подтверждения (B2) отправляешь ты из Revenelle: напоминания каждое утро, подтверждения сразу, как только запись создана или изменена. Текст готовит Revenelle, B1 и B2 показывают, как он должен звучать. Потом работаешь с теми, кто не ответил: утром – по первым записям дня, с 14:00 – по завтрашним (B3), в 17:00 – звонок. B1 Напоминание – из Revenelle, каждое утро Отправляешь утром из Revenelle по предстоящим записям, которые он показывает. Hi [Name], a friendly reminder that we have you booked tomorrow, [day, date] at [time], for your [procedure] with Dr. Diana / our beauty therapist. Could you please confirm that you'll be coming? Just a quick "yes" or "see you tomorrow" works. B2 Подтверждение в день визита – из Revenelle Отправляешь из Revenelle утром в день визита. Good morning, [Name]! Just confirming we're seeing you today at [time]. Looking forward to it – see you soon. B3 Follow-up неответившему (отправляешь ты) С 14:00 – всем, кто не ответил на напоминание. Можно добавить последнюю строку про 17:00. Если к 17:00 ответа так и нет – звонок. Hi [Name], just checking in – could you please confirm your visit tomorrow at [time]? We want to make sure everything is ready for you. [optional] If we don't hear from you by 5 pm, we'll need to release the slot. C. Отмена и перенос Обработка запросов на отмену или перенос. Правила – в разделе 4 и на странице про запись , полные скрипты – в SOP. C1 Поздняя отмена или no-show, fee был оплачен – первый раз Признать, объяснить правило, сохранить fee один раз как исключение, предупредить о следующем разе, спросить про новую дату. Оставить комментарий в карточке. Hi [Name], thank you for letting us know. As per our booking conditions, the reservation fee is non-refundable for changes made less than 24 hours in advance. As an exception this time, we'll keep your 210 AED reservation fee for 3 months so you can use it for your next visit. Please note this can only be done once – if a booking is missed or cancelled late again, the fee will not be kept. Do you already have a date in mind, or shall we reach out a bit later? C1b Поздняя отмена или no-show, fee не было – первый раз Записываем как исключение и предупреждаем, что в следующий раз нужен будет reservation fee. Оставить комментарий в карточке. Hi [Name], thank you for letting us know. Because this change came less than 24 hours before the appointment, our policy is to ask for a 210 AED reservation fee for future bookings. As this is the first time, we'll make an exception and rebook you without it – but if a booking is cancelled late or missed again, the next one will need a reservation fee (fully credited toward your treatment). When would you like to come in instead? C2 Отмена за 24 часа и больше Обычный перенос. Если fee был оплачен, он переходит на новую запись. Of course, [Name] – no problem at all, thank you for letting us know in advance. [If a fee was paid:] Your reservation fee stays with us and is valid for 3 months. When would you like to come in instead? Do you already have a preferred day, or shall I suggest a few options? C3 Подтверждение переноса Perfect, [Name] – I've moved your booking to [new day, date] at [time] with [specialist]. [If a fee was paid:] Your reservation fee is applied to this visit. I'll send you a reminder closer to the date. See you then! D. No-show и follow-up После пропущенного визита, follow-up после посещения, запрос Google-отзыва. D1 После no-show (в тот же или на следующий день) Отправляется после no-show, когда клиент не ответил на звонки. Тон тёплый, не упрекающий. Когда ответит – C1 или C1b. Hi [Name], we missed you on [day, date] and hope everything is well on your side. Would you like to find another time? I'd be happy to look at the schedule with you. D2 Follow-up через 3 дня Отправляется в WhatsApp через 3 дня после процедуры. Искренняя забота, не продажа. Hi [Name], hope you've been doing well after your visit on [day]! How are you feeling, and how is your skin settling? If anything has come up or you have any questions, please don't hesitate to let us know – we're here. D3 Запрос Google-отзыва (в follow-up) Использовать только если клиент не оставил отзыв в клинике. Объединяется с D2. [continuing from D2] If you have a moment and you're happy with your experience at Cosmo Di, a short Google review would mean the world to us – it really helps other women discover us. Here's the link: [Google review link] Thank you so much for being with us. E. Реактивация спящей базы Контакт с клиентами, которые не были у нас 60+ дней. Индивидуально, не массово. Не офферы – вопросы. Перед отправкой – открой карточку клиента. Подстрой каждый шаблон под конкретную процедуру, которую он делал, его предпочтения, что-то личное, что ты о нём знаешь. E1 60–90 дней (тёплый сегмент) Упоминаешь последнюю процедуру естественно. Фокус – «как ваша кожа». Hi [Name], it's been about [X] weeks since your [procedure] with us, and we just wanted to check in – how is your skin feeling? Are you happy with how the result has been holding? If anything is on your mind, or if it feels like a good time to plan the next step, we'd love to hear from you. E2 90–180 дней (средний) Больше пространства, чтобы клиент задумался. Открываем дверь, не давим. Hi [Name], it's been a little while since we last saw you, and I wanted to reach out personally to ask – how have things been on the skin care side? Sometimes a few months after a [procedure type / treatment course], a gentle touch-up or refresh can really help maintain the result. If you'd like, Dr. Diana could take a look and suggest what makes sense at this stage – no pressure either way. Would it be helpful to chat about it? E3 180+ дней (холодный) Длиннее. Искренний интерес. Будь открыта к ответу «больше не вернёмся» как нормальному. Hi [Name], it's been quite some time since we've heard from you, and I wanted to reach out – not to sell you anything, but genuinely to ask how you are. How is your skin feeling these days? Is there anything we could have done differently, or anything that didn't work for you last time? Whatever your answer, we'd really value hearing it. And if at any point you feel like coming back for a fresh assessment, Dr. Diana would be glad to see you. E4 Заполнение свободного слота (проактивно) Когда есть пробел в расписании на завтра, и ты хочешь пригласить конкретного клиента. Hi [Name], a slot opened up tomorrow at [time] with Dr. Diana / our beauty therapist – and you came to mind. If you've been thinking about [procedure / treatment], this could be a lovely opportunity. Would it work for you? F. Жалобы и сложные ситуации Медицинские вопросы, проблемы с сервисом, запросы скидок. Всегда по-человечески, не корпоративно. F1 Вопрос о результате или реакции Клиент пишет о реакции кожи, боли, неожиданном эффекте. Не интерпретируй. Возможное осложнение – сразу специалисту, дежурному врачу или медсестре; всё остальное – по разделу 12 . Hi [Name], thank you for letting us know – let's make sure this is taken care of right away. I'll pass this to [specialist], who performed your procedure, so they can review it. Could you please send a few clear photos and a short description of what you're noticing? I'll come back to you as soon as I have their feedback. F2 Жалоба на сервис – признать и разобраться Задержка, путаница, что-либо связанное с опытом клиента. Скажи, что тебе жаль, что клиент недоволен, не оправдывайся и не обещай компенсацию. Потом проверь факты и сообщи Clinic Manager ( раздел 12 ). [Name], I'm really sorry to hear about your experience – we take this seriously. I'm looking into what happened and will come back to you by [day]. Again, thank you for telling us – it genuinely matters. F3 Запрос скидки – когда ты решаешь её не давать Используй, когда скидка не оправдана (лимиты – в разделе 10 ). Признай запрос и объясни ценность. Если клиент просит больше твоего лимита – пиши Clinic Manager. Hi [Name], thank you for asking. Our pricing reflects the level of care, the premium products we use, and the individual approach Dr. Diana takes with every client. For this reason, we generally don't offer discounts. What we can do is make sure the plan recommended for you is truly the most efficient one for your priorities – Dr. Diana is very mindful about that during consultation. Would it help to chat about which procedures would give you the most value? G. Возражения Не защищай цену – объясняй ценность. Не спорь – предложи следующий шаг. G1 " Дорого " I completely understand – and that's a fair thing to consider. Our pricing reflects the level of care, premium products, and individual approach Dr. Diana takes with every client. It's why our clients tend to come back and stay with us. The best way to see if it's right for you is a consultation – Dr. Diana will recommend the most efficient plan within your priorities, so you know exactly what you're investing in. Would you like to come in for that? G2 " Я подумаю " Of course, [Name] – take your time. Is there something specific you'd like to think over, or any information that would help you decide? In the meantime, would it be okay if I check in with you in a week or so? G3 " У меня есть свой косметолог " Lovely to hear you have someone you trust – that matters. If ever you're curious about a specific procedure we offer (like Morpheus8, or our biorevitalization protocols, or our Wonder Axon body work), we'd be happy to share more, no pressure at all. In the meantime – we're here whenever you'd like to chat. G4 " У конкурентов дешевле " Pricing varies a lot in Dubai depending on the protocols, the products, and the doctor's approach – so the headline price doesn't always tell the full story. What matters most is the result, and how it holds. If you'd like, Dr. Diana can do a Procedure Consultation, give you a clear plan, and you can decide from there whether the value works for you. Would you like to book that? Закрывающие реплики Фразы для красивого закрытия разговора, когда запись подтверждена или клиент берёт время на решение. Z1 После подтверждения записи All set, [Name] – we'll see you on [day] at [time]. If anything comes up before then, just let us know. Looking forward to it! Z2 Когда клиент не определился Take your time, [Name]. Whenever you're ready, we're here – no rush at all. О тоне Эти шаблоны написаны в тёплом, премиум-тоне. Каждое слово подобрано – глаголы вроде «wonderful», «lovely», «of course»; открытия типа «happy to share», «thank you for asking»; закрытия типа «looking forward to it», «we're here». Это не call-центровый английский и не повседневный мессенджерский. Это голос клиники, которая серьёзно относится к своим клиентам. Если шаблон кажется слишком формальным для конкретного клиента (некоторые клиенты предпочитают очень короткие ответы) – смягчи. Если кажется слишком неформальным (некоторые клиенты очень официальны) – сделай чуть более сдержанным. Шаблоны – стартовые точки, твоё суждение о конкретном клиенте – последнее слово.
